title: fix: include voodoohop in quest leaderboards
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Removed the voodoohop-specific exclusion from public and monthly Quest leaderboards. New reported-issue rewards are no longer recorded for this opted-out maintainer account; other GitHub Quest rewards are unchanged. A separate scoped D1 operation is planned to remove 113 existing reported-issue reward rows, while keeping the 47 Quest Pollen already credited to the wallet. Added regression tests for the leaderboard and reward behavior.
